# Pictomino — Free Spatial Reasoning Puzzle Game for Kids

> A cat-themed spatial reasoning puzzle game where kids drag and drop puzzle pieces to complete grids. 10 levels, 5 lives, no guessing required.

## Main Pages

- [Play Game](https://spatialreasoninggame.com/): Main game page with interactive spatial reasoning puzzle
- [Easy Mode](https://spatialreasoninggame.com/easy/): Beginner-friendly 3×3 grid with 7 lives
- [Hard Mode](https://spatialreasoninggame.com/hard/): Challenge mode with 4×4 to 5×5 grids, 12 pieces, 5 lives
- [Daily Puzzle](https://spatialreasoninggame.com/daily-puzzle/): New puzzle every day with streak tracking

## SEO Content

- [Cat Breeds Guide](https://spatialreasoninggame.com/cat-breeds/): Learn about cat breeds while playing
- [Animal Puzzles](https://spatialreasoninggame.com/animal-puzzles/): Animal-themed puzzle variations
- [Blog](https://spatialreasoninggame.com/blog/): Tips, strategies, and puzzle game news
